title: Welcome to Risa!
description:
Just 13 miles from the airport, this gorgeous home will make your stay in Tennessee a lot more convenient. Mount Juliet has a great shopping area and tons of local places for lots of fun. Less than 20 miles and you're in Nashville! Lots of space for the whole family or group of friends. Small movie theater, indoor and outdoor fireplace, large backyard with canopy, full kitchen, and small bar. A large driveway for up to 4 cars. Come explore Nashville, then enjoy some peace in this beautiful town.

Other things to note
When you book Risa, we want you to enjoy your time with us worry free. Tidying up is appreciated but NOT required. we have a fantastic cleaning crew! All we ask is that
you don't damage the place.
